rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for flooding in streets, homes, or other local areas.

example.english: The heavy rain has caused the whole street to flood.
example.traditional: 呢場大雨搞到成條街都水浸喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 daai6 jyu5 gaau2 dou3 seng4 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 seoi2 zam3 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a large-scale natural flood or disaster, especially in news or more formal descriptions.

example.english: News reports said the flood affected several low-lying areas.
example.traditional: 新聞報道指，洪水令多個低窪地區受災。
example.jyutping: san1 man4 bou3 dou6 zi2 hung4 seoi2 ling6 do1 go3 dai1 waa1 dei6 keoi1 sau6 zoi1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when an area becomes flooded with water.

example.english: Last night's heavy rain caused a flood across the whole street.
example.traditional: 琴晚場大雨搞到成條街都水浸。
example.jyutping: kam4 maan5 coeng4 daai6 jyu5 gaau2 dou3 seng4 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 seoi2 zam3

rows.note: Use this when a surface or space is covered or filled with liquid.

example.english: It rained all night, and water began to flood the whole floor.
example.traditional: 大雨落咗一晚，成個地下都浸滿晒水。
example.jyutping: daai6 jyu5 lok6 zo2 jat1 maan5 seng4 go3 dei6 haa6 dou1 zam3 mun5 saai3 seoi2

rows.note: Use this for a sudden, overwhelming wave or batch of complaints, requests, or similar things.

example.english: A flood of complaints came pouring in, and the customer service team was rushed off its feet.
example.traditional: 一大輪投訴湧埋嚟，客服部忙到停唔到手。
example.jyutping: jat1 daai6 leon4 tau4 sou3 jung2 maai4 lei4 haak3 fuk6 bou6 mong4 dou3 ting4 m4 dou3 sau2

rows.note: Use this for bombarding someone with a large volume of calls, complaints, or messages.

example.english: The customers flood us with dozens of complaints every day.
example.traditional: 啲客成日轟幾十個投訴畀我哋。
example.jyutping: di1 haak3 seng4 jat6 gwang1 gei2 sap6 go3 tau4 sou3 bei2 ngo5 dei6
